name: Ulaanbaatar
author: turnerawill12345-a11y
description:
Discover Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia’s vibrant capital, where modern urban development meets centuries of history and tradition.

Situated in the Tuul River valley and surrounded by rolling hills, Ulaanbaatar is a city of contrasts, from the bustling streets of Sükhbaatar Square and the commercial districts of the city centre to sprawling residential neighbourhoods, traditional ger districts and rapidly expanding suburbs.
